preservation_rule: The candidate is not discarded. Its evidence-validation, fail-closed and authority-separation logic is reusable implementation work. Its hosted PASS remains historical evidence for its exact candidate-local contract only and is not transferred to the reconciled current-parent subject.

audit_findings.finding: Candidate parentDigest(state) hashes the entire object locally. Current Book parent authority uses an explicit sealed state_digest computed with state_digest excluded. Candidate fixtures omit state_digest, so the 70/70 matrix did not exercise the canonical current-parent digest contract.
audit_findings.required_repair: Use current Version/Rollback parent validation and sealState/state_digest identity. expected_parent_state_digest must equal the validated current state_digest; the successor must be resealed and carry a valid new state_digest.

audit_findings.finding: Candidate state fixtures use active references to governing brief/canon/story-plan objects while those collections are empty. They are sufficient for candidate-local tests but are not a valid current canonical Book parent under the qualified Version/Rollback parent validator.
audit_findings.required_repair: Rebuild final qualification fixtures from a valid current sealed parent fixture and run current parent validation on every positive path.

audit_findings.finding: Candidate contract states Book authority, but its request shape and runtime do not require or validate actor_class=PARENT_SYSTEM.
audit_findings.required_repair: Require actor_class and fail closed on any provider, Prose, Book Evaluator, Document System or other non-parent actor.

audit_findings.finding: Candidate emits a receipt but its 70-case qualifier does not prove that the final receipt is accepted by the current qualified Version/Rollback runtime as authority_kind=EXPORT_RELEASE using exact current sealed pre/post parent identities.
audit_findings.required_repair: Add a real recordAuthorizedParentSuccessor integration case with authority_kind=EXPORT_RELEASE and the final release receipt.

audit_findings.finding: Candidate correctly avoids lifecycle mutation and emits EXPORT_FREEZE_READY, but predates the proven Lifecycle keyed-object/current sealed-parent incompatibility and therefore does not prove the release can drive FINALIZATION->EXPORT_FROZEN on the current parent.
audit_findings.required_repair: After the compatibility adapter receives authoritative A-01 PASS, add an end-to-end qualification case: release append -> Version/Rollback EXPORT_RELEASE record -> compatibility adapter delegates unchanged Lifecycle v1 FINALIZATION->EXPORT_FROZEN -> Version/Rollback LIFECYCLE_TRANSITION record.

audit_findings.finding: Candidate finder supports manuscript_id/version_id/manuscript_ref matching, but its fixture active canonical_manuscript_ref is manuscript-id-only. Current Book fixtures commonly bind active canonical manuscript to an exact version-qualified ref.
audit_findings.required_repair: Resolve manuscript identity through the current parent object-record semantics and bind exact manuscript_id, version_id and artifact_digest rather than relying on permissive ref alternatives.

audit_findings.finding: Candidate uses ELIGIBLE/CURRENT/VALID vocabulary while the current canonical Export Freeze contract uses explicit CURRENT_AUTHORIZED, CURRENT_ALLOWED and CURRENT_FOR_BOUND_SOURCE_AND_ARTIFACT semantics.
audit_findings.required_repair: Normalize the final reconciled contract/runtime to the current canonical vocabulary or provide an explicit versioned mapping; do not silently equate weaker states.

audit_findings.finding: Candidate accepts accessibility_state=NOT_APPLICABLE without requiring an accompanying rationale/profile basis.
audit_findings.required_repair: Use NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_RATIONALE and bind it to the selected target-medium profile.

audit_findings.finding: Candidate correctly keeps lifecycle status unchanged in the freeze transaction and explicitly denies publication, author-choice synthesis and document-byte mutation.

Candidate has strong fail-closed validation for exact artifact/source/profile identity, POST_LAYOUT_PROOF_COMPLETE, format validation, source-to-render integrity, accessibility, proof, correction ledger, changed bytes, provenance and rights/privacy currentness.
Candidate correctly uses one release identity per format artifact digest, append-only supersession lineage and no frozen-digest rewrite.

Candidate snapshot-backed idempotency, exact replay and conflict handling are valuable, but final replay must be rebound to the current sealed parent/receipt identity and tested after Version/Rollback recording.

reuse_substantially: 70-case adversarial test ideas and most negative cases
do_not_transfer: candidate 70/70 hosted PASS to reconciled runtime

final_reconciled_qualification_minimum: All reusable candidate negative cases continue to pass under current sealed parent semantics.
Positive path begins from validateParentState(current sealed parent).
Freeze appends exactly one release and produces a valid sealed parent successor whose lifecycle status remains FINALIZATION.
Version/Rollback accepts the exact release receipt under EXPORT_RELEASE authority.
Qualified current-parent Lifecycle adapter accepts the appended release as EXPORT_FREEZE_READY and delegates unchanged Lifecycle v1 to EXPORT_FROZEN.
Version/Rollback accepts the adapted Lifecycle receipt under LIFECYCLE_TRANSITION authority.
Changed final reconciled bytes receive fresh hosted qualification and registered A-01 exact-SHA qualification.
current_blocker: BOOK-SYSTEM-LIFECYCLE-CURRENT-PARENT-COMPATIBILITY-ADAPTER-001 requires shared A-01 registration and authoritative exact-SHA PASS before Export Freeze implementation is reconciled into canonical Book control.
